pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark regions exhibit sharp polygonal geometry with highly irregular, jagged boundaries and high-contrast pixel gradients. Spatial area varies from small angular fragments near the spine to larger, elongated regions on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light pelage forms a continuous branching network. Junction nodes primarily consist of three-way intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively thin and consistent, maintaining high pixel-level continuity across the observed flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane along the neck and shoulder presents a continuous 1D jagged silhouette with low-amplitude and high-frequency serrations against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian subject (oxpecker) perched on the dorsal ridge at the shoulder-neck transition.
